preToolUse.bash: i=$(cat); c=$(printf '%s' "$i" | sed -n 's/.*"cwd":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | tr '\\\\' '/' | tr -s '/'); r=""; if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -d "$c" ]; then r="$c"; else dl=$(printf '%s' "$c" | sed -n 's|^\([A-Za-z]\):/.*|\1|p' | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z'); rest=$(printf '%s' "$c" | sed -n 's|^[A-Za-z]:/\(.*\)|\1|p'); if [ -n "$dl" ]; then for cand in "/mnt/$dl/$rest" "/$dl/$rest"; do if [ -d "$cand" ]; then r="$cand"; break; fi; done; fi; fi; [ -n "$r" ] || exit 0; g="$r/.github/hooks/sdlc-tdd-guard.sh"; [ -f "$g" ] || exit 0; printf '%s' "$i" | SDLC_REPO_ROOT="$r" sh "$g" pre-write
